method: tubes <C> <S>   the hidden-tube offset of every registered piece of candidate C, brain S: labels/tube_landmarks_r054.py (hole_hidden rule)
unchanged except its inputs: the candidate's TIRL folder (data_tirl_sweep/<C>/sub-<S>/tirl/<piece>), the piece masks the
candidate's moving images were built from (C0..C6: data_tirl_sweep/inputs/.../_work/histo_masks; REC: the record's), and the
pre-inpaint fixed image of record (data_arm_preinp/.../tirl/<piece>/fixed.png) -> labels/tirl_sweep/tubes/<C>_<S>/<piece>.json
aggregate       per candidate (C0..C6; REC = the record's settings on the record's inputs, validation only):
hidden-tube offset: detection count; median over pieces found under BOTH the candidate and C0 (paired), per brain and pooled
tissue Dice (labels/qc_histo2bf.piece_qc): median affine and nonlinear Dice, count of nonlinear Dice < 0.85
screen flags: affine Dice < 0.8; nonlinear gain over affine > 0.12
leave-one-brain-out: in each of the 6 folds the candidate with the best pooled paired improvement on the five other brains is
picked; stable = picked AND improving the held-out brain in >= 4 of 6 folds
decision rule (fixed before any run): adopt only if (a) pooled paired median improves by >= 0.03 mm, (b) the per-brain paired
median improves in >= 4 of 6 brains, (c) median nonlinear Dice falls by no more than 0.005 and the count < 0.85 does not rise,
(d) stable; C7: when two or more single changes pass on their own, their combination is to be run once (same test, same rule).
(d) picks one candidate per fold, so it can hold for at most one; "on its own" therefore uses per-candidate stability: in >= 4
of 6 folds the candidate meets (a) on the other five brains and improves the held-out brain (reported as d_own_stable).
C0 against the record (the mask fix alone) is reported too.
Failed runs (1 Nov 2026, fixed before any scoring): a run that did not reach the nonlinear stage is a lost
detection (counted in the detection counts, absent from the pairs) and is listed with its stage (the first stage without
its output) and error (the worker log's exception line); a candidate that fails on any piece is not adoptable as it stands
(the record registers every piece) and does not count toward the C7 trigger (f_no_failures).
A registered piece whose tube search window (around the tube center mapped into the histology) lies wholly outside the
histology image makes the tube scorer stop (glymur read error); it is a lost detection too (tube_window_outside_histology).

rule.failures: any failed piece -> not adoptable, no C7 trigger
